instructions: Choose the one current anchor whose text best matches the orphaned human comment quote and its context. The candidates are deterministic current anchors supplied with the question. Choose none when no candidate is a credible move for the passage. Do not infer a new anchor or treat a deleted passage as moved.

labels.name: candidate
labels.description: One current anchor is a credible location for the orphaned passage because its section preserves the quoted subject and context.
examples: A comment on an old topology section can move to workbench-system.spec.html#topology after the canonical content moved there and the old anchor became a compatibility link. (annotateanything spec history)

A comment on the old delivery section can move to delivery-lifecycle.spec.html#delivery after the canonical content moved there and the old anchor remained as a compatibility link. (annotateanything spec history)

A comment quoting the Jev flow can move to the current flow or shared section when the ANN-100 spec reshaped its swimlane and retained the same server, provider, and cache subjects. (spec-chat ANN-100 history, 42ee440)
